parameters.name: input_dir
parameters.description: Folder holding the .nrrd field and the Slicer .h5 transforms, e.g. /data/841260_manual_refinement

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: Processed dataset name or s3:// URI the refinement belongs to

parameters.name: annotator
parameters.description: Full name of whoever placed the landmarks

parameters.name: replace
parameters.description: true to replace a refinement already published for this dataset (optional)

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: true to validate and write processing.json to /results without uploading (optional)
